Title: Project scaffolding & CI test harness
Description: Stand up the regagg module inside the MCP server repo with an isolated pytest harness (in-memory DB + temp storage) runnable on every commit.
Acceptance Criteria: Module imports cleanly inside host server; pytest suite runs offline in <10s; CI-safe fixtures for DB and storage exist

Title: Regulator configuration schema & loader
Description: Strict pydantic model for per-regulator YAML (connector type, sources, fetch method, rate limits, doc-type rules, backfill cutoff) with a fail-fast loader.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid/unknown fields rejected at load; connector↔sources cross-validated; filename must match declared id; loader collects all errors for reporting

Title: Author 30 regulator configs + controlled taxonomy
Description: One YAML per regulator across CA/US/EU-UK/APAC/INTL plus the controlled tag taxonomy and global settings files.
Acceptance Criteria: 30 configs parse and validate; taxonomy doc-types match code constants; every source starts verified:false

Title: Corpus database schema (9 tables)
Description: SQLAlchemy models on the shared base for documents, versions, tags, edges, pending-edges, seen-URLs, runs, watermarks, regulators; matching hand-authored Postgres DDL.
Acceptance Criteria: Tables auto-create on both SQLite and Postgres; one-current-per-doc expressible; FKs and CHECK constraints enforced; DDL file shipped

Title: Corpus storage layout over storage abstraction
Description: Normalized folder layout (current/archive/staging/_state per regulator) implemented over the host's local/S3 storage backend with artifact read/write helpers.
Acceptance Criteria: Layout identical for all regulators; copy/delete tree operations work on local and S3 semantics; meta.json round-trips

Title: Foundation verification gate
Description: A no-network CI gate proving configs parse, taxonomy is in sync, and all corpus tables register/create.
Acceptance Criteria: Single command exits non-zero on any foundation defect; run in CI on every commit

Title: Source verification harness
Description: Automated verifier for every candidate source: reachability, content-type, parseability (incl. sitemap indexes), freshness; produces a per-regulator report.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass/warn/fail per source with reasons; sitemap-index recognized; report renders to markdown; harness is the only authority for verified:true

Title: Fixture recorder & per-regulator parse tests
Description: Record each regulator's real source payloads once and run every connector against its recording in CI.
Acceptance Criteria: Fixtures recorded for all reachable regulators; parametrized test per regulator passes offline; recordings size-capped

Title: BA: source map validation & regulator list sign-off
Description: Validate the proposed 30-regulator list and candidate sources against business priorities; obtain sign-off.
Acceptance Criteria: Signed-off regulator list; discrepancies (dead feeds, blocked sites) logged as onboarding risks

Title: PM: sprint ceremonies, RAID log, stakeholder reporting
Description: Recurring per-sprint PM allocation (~25%): planning, standups, review/retro, risk and dependency management.
Acceptance Criteria: Ceremonies held; RAID log current; sprint report issued

Title: Atomic versioning protocol (override→archive)
Description: Six-step crash-safe protocol: stage new version, record intent, copy current to timestamped archive, promote staging, finalize document row.
Acceptance Criteria: New doc creates v1; changed content archives prior version and increments version; unchanged content is a no-op; document identity stable across revisions

Title: Crash-recovery reconciliation & invariant audit
Description: Deterministic repair job that rolls half-applied updates forward, cleans orphan staging, and audits invariants (exactly one current per doc; archive append-only).
Acceptance Criteria: After any induced crash, reconcile restores a clean state with zero committed-data loss; violations are reported, never silently fixed twice

Title: Chaos test suite for the versioning path
Description: Automated tests that kill the pipeline after every protocol step and assert full recovery.
Acceptance Criteria: Crash injected at each of steps 1–5; invariants hold post-reconcile in all cases; reconcile idempotent

Title: Sitemap-diff connector
Description: Detect new/changed URLs from sitemap.xml (incl. index recursion) plus listing pages, with lastmod fast-path skipping and include/exclude filters.
Acceptance Criteria: Sitemap+listing union deduplicated; known URLs with unchanged lastmod skipped; doc-type mapped from URL rules

Title: RSS/Atom connector
Description: Poll 1..n feeds per regulator with GUID→URL dedup, malformed-feed isolation, and backfill-cutoff filtering.
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate GUIDs collapse; items older than cutoff ignored; one bad feed never aborts others

Title: API connector & Federal Register adapter
Description: Provider-adapter API connector; Federal Register: agency filters, explicit field selection, pagination to cutoff, sanctioned full-text URL, abstract capture.
Acceptance Criteria: Paginates until backfill cutoff; emits reference numbers for dedup; requests raw_text_url+abstract explicitly (not in default fields)

Title: Fetch & normalization layer
Description: Polite fetcher (UA, per-domain rate limit) converting HTML→markdown (boilerplate stripped) and PDF→markdown, detecting PDFs by magic bytes, flagging scanned files.
Acceptance Criteria: HTML preserves headings/tables/links; .pdf URLs serving HTML are treated as HTML (magic-byte truth); scanned PDFs flagged ocr:true; content sha256 computed

Title: BA: provenance & audit acceptance walkthrough
Description: Define and verify the governance chain a compliance reviewer needs: source URL, final URL, hash, timestamps, run attribution, raw original, version lineage.
Acceptance Criteria: Walkthrough from rendered doc back to original bytes and run manifest demonstrated; gaps (post-redirect URL) closed

Title: PM: sprint ceremonies & reporting
Description: Recurring PM allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: As S1

Title: End-to-end ingestion pipeline
Description: Wire detect→fetch→version→enrich→record per regulator: run manifests, seen-URL registry, per-URL error isolation, idempotent reruns.
Acceptance Criteria: One bad document never fails a run; rerun same day is a no-op for unchanged content; manifest lists every URL with outcome; run row persisted

Title: Policy-PDF harvesting
Description: Extract same-domain PDF links from ingested HTML pages and ingest them as first-class policy documents (source_kind=policy_pdf), with per-page and per-run caps.
Acceptance Criteria: PDFs enter the same versioning path; source_kind recorded; caps prevent runaway; 3/page, 40/run defaults

Title: Meta-source deduplication
Description: When the meta-source (Federal Register) lists a document an agency feed already provided, keep the agency copy canonical and skip the duplicate by reference number.
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate skipped and counted (deduped metric); no double-counting across fedreg/agency

Title: Fleet orchestrator
Description: Fan out one isolated run per active regulator; support rerun of all/subset/one for a chosen date; expose reconcile as an operation.
Acceptance Criteria: One regulator's hard failure never blocks others; rerun records operator identity; reruns are idempotent

Title: Run status semantics & live progress
Description: Humane statuses (failed only when nothing landed or >20% errored) plus mid-run counter flushes so the UI can show live progress.
Acceptance Criteria: Partial-error runs show success + error count; counters update at least every 10 documents during a run

Title: Pilot regulators end-to-end (OSFI, FRB, FedReg)
Description: Prove all three connector types live against the pilot trio, including a forced content change correctly archiving v1.
Acceptance Criteria: All pilots ingest live; update archives prior version; fixtures recorded

Title: Onboarding wave 1 — fifteen fast regulators
Description: Verify sources and run first live ingestion for the non-giant regulators across all regions.
Acceptance Criteria: Each has ≥1 verified source and a passing live run; failures triaged with per-URL evidence

Title: Crawl hardening
Description: Protect the fleet from pathological sources: sitemap byte cap, sitemap-index child cap, giants-last ordering with per-giant caps, tuned timeouts.
Acceptance Criteria: A monster sitemap cannot hang a run (logged truncation); giants capped per run; hardening covered by tests

Title: Bot-block guard & sanctioned fallbacks
Description: Detect anti-scraping block pages and fall back to official API abstract, else an honest metadata stub — provenance labels content_source; never store block-page garbage; never evade.
Acceptance Criteria: Block page never stored as content; fallback chain full-text→abstract→stub; content_source recorded; zero recurring error storms

Title: BA: dashboard information architecture & status vocabulary
Description: Define analyst/operator journeys, coverage semantics (fresh/stale/attention), and plain-language status labels for the UI.
Acceptance Criteria: IA for 5 pages agreed; status color/meaning table documented

Title: PM: sprint ceremonies & reporting
Description: Recurring PM allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: As S1

Title: Dashboard data API
Description: Read endpoints backing every page: coverage tree with roll-ups, corpus browse with facets, changes feed, run overview with daily delta, version diff, inventory, jailed file explorer.
Acceptance Criteria: All endpoints stateless and paginated where relevant; institution filters applied in SQL before LIMIT; fs endpoints jailed to corpus root

Title: Coverage page
Description: Region→institution expandable tree: web/PDF counts, new-in-window, last run, freshness pill, coverage-% vs source-advertised, per-row Run trigger.
Acceptance Criteria: Coverage % shown per institution; staleness flagged per config threshold; Run button triggers a real audited run

Title: Corpus browser page
Description: Dedicated deep-linkable page: continent/institution/file-type/doc-type/status/date/search filters with live facet counts, title+reference+excerpt rows, source links, Published+Added columns, pagination.
Acceptance Criteria: All filters server-side; facet counts reflect scope; row opens document drawer; 50/page with prev/next

Title: Collection-runs page
Description: Operations view: today's delta banner with pass-rate headline and failing-run digest, live active-run progress (5s polling), recent runs, daily delta history.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass-rate = fetched/(fetched+errors); live counters tick during runs; every run links to its manifest

Title: Reference-number grammar & citation mining
Description: Regex grammars for regulator identifiers (OSFI B/E-series, CAR/LAR chapters, SR letters, OCC bulletins, NI, APS, PS/CP/SS, RTS/ITS, BCBS…) extracting a document's own reference and its citations, with sentence-scoped supersede detection.
Acceptance Criteria: Own-reference extracted from titles; citations classified supersedes vs references without cross-sentence bleed; adding a grammar is a table entry

Title: Cross-reference knowledge graph
Description: Resolve citations against the corpus into typed edges with confidence; supersedes edges flip target status; unresolved citations persist and retry nightly.
Acceptance Criteria: Edges deduplicated; supersedes updates target to superseded; pending edges resolve when the target arrives

Title: Expected-inventory reconciliation (completeness proof)
Description: Per-regulator expected inventories (seeded: OSFI CAR/LAR/B/E series) reconciled against the corpus by reference then title; per-series present/missing report and API.
Acceptance Criteria: Answers 'do we hold every chapter?' with named gaps; OSFI reconciles 30/30 after gap-fill

Title: Onboarding wave 2 — giants & source remediation
Description: Onboard the large/broken regulators: capped depth-slicing for giants; fix dead feeds (FDIC), connector switches (HKMA + 5 RSS-dead regs → listing/sitemap), sitemap-index support (CSA).
Acceptance Criteria: 29/30 regulators verified and collecting; each fix re-verified by the harness; AMF escalated (not evaded)

Title: Targeted gap-fill runs
Description: URL-regex-scoped ingest (e.g. /en/guidance) so specific sections can be completed without full-site crawls; used to complete OSFI's guideline chapters.
Acceptance Criteria: Scoped run ingests only matching URLs; OSFI guidance section filled (363 docs) driving inventory to complete

Title: BA: UAT round 1 (coverage/corpus/runs)
Description: Structured UAT of the first three pages against analyst/operator journeys; log and triage defects.
Acceptance Criteria: UAT script executed; defects logged with severity; blocking defects fixed before sprint close

Title: PM: sprint ceremonies & reporting
Description: Recurring PM allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: As S1

Title: Changes / impact feed
Description: Analyst delta feed: NEW/REVISED/SUPERSEDED/DEADLINE cards grouped by day, filtered by region, institution, file type, change-type chips, and explicit date range — all server-side.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters share coverage-tree dimensions; counts remain pre-kind-filter for tile toggles; feed matches DB deltas exactly

Title: Version diff viewer
Description: One-click unified diff between a document's current and previous archived version with added/removed counts, from the Changes feed and drawer.
Acceptance Criteria: Diff renders color-coded; single-version docs report 'no diff' cleanly

Title: Rich document drawer
Description: Document view with tabs: rendered markdown (self-contained md→html, no CDN), summary, provenance rail (all governance fields incl. final URL/fetch method/content source), raw text.
Acceptance Criteria: Headings/lists/tables/links render; provenance shows source URL clickable; raw preserved verbatim

Title: Corpus file Explorer
Description: Nested file-tree page mirroring disk (regulator→current|archive→doc_type→year→doc→artifacts) with lazy loading; text files open in drawer, originals download; API jailed to corpus root.
Acceptance Criteria: Path traversal rejected (400); item counts and sizes shown; md renders rich

Title: Manual interjection & upload lane
Description: Human override: add/update a document by URL fetch, pasted corrected markdown, or uploaded PDF/HTML — via UI modal, API, and CLI — through the identical versioning/provenance path, tagged manual and audited.
Acceptance Criteria: Update archives prior version; operator identity recorded; run row visible; future crawls recognize the URL (no duplicates); 50MB upload cap

Title: Content-plane MCP tools
Description: reg_search (filter-then-rank), reg_read (summary|full|meta|historical version), reg_tags, reg_whats_new, reg_graph — stateless, registered via config-driven dynamic discovery.
Acceptance Criteria: All five discoverable and callable over MCP; filters applied before ranking; graph traversal cycle-safe depth≤3

Title: Index-plane MCP tools
Description: reg_coverage, reg_browse (metadata-only), reg_changes, reg_diff, reg_inventory, reg_runs_status, reg_trigger_run (mutating, guarded) — the answers content-RAG cannot give.
Acceptance Criteria: All seven callable over MCP with the same filters as the UI; trigger refuses concurrent runs and records operator

Title: MCP security & key lifecycle
Description: Authentication required for tools/call (discovery stays open); per-key tool allowlists enforced at the transport; scoped agent key issued, rotated, and stored DB-only (never committed).
Acceptance Criteria: No-key and dead-key calls rejected; out-of-scope tool denied; in-scope tool works — four-way matrix verified; rotation procedure documented

Title: BA: UAT round 2 (changes/diff/explorer/manual)
Description: Structured UAT of the remaining pages and the manual lane.
Acceptance Criteria: UAT script executed; defects triaged; sign-off recorded

Title: PM: sprint ceremonies & reporting
Description: Recurring PM allocation.
Acceptance Criteria: As S1

Title: Markdown projection for the agent stack
Description: Maintain the corpus in the agent tools' consumption layout — data/markdown/{web|policy}/{regulator}/{doc_type}/{doc_id}.md with YAML frontmatter — via write-through on every ingest plus nightly resync self-heal.
Acceptance Criteria: Every current document has exactly one projection file; frontmatter carries citation context; resync idempotent; history stays in canonical store

Title: Agent-platform MCP connectivity
Description: Connect the existing agent stack to the MCP endpoint with the scoped key; verify end-to-end tool calls and denial of out-of-scope tools.
Acceptance Criteria: initialize/tools list/call verified from client side; connection details documented for the platform's custom-MCP dialog

Title: Chatbot enablement guide
Description: Author the integration guide: connection block, agent prompt pattern (narrow→read cheap→relate→freshness), non-negotiable citation rule, worked examples, honest limitations, go-live eval checklist.
Acceptance Criteria: Guide sufficient for the chatbot team to integrate without our involvement

Title: Agent skills authoring
Description: Author skill definitions on the agent platform mapping to the tools: Daily Regulatory Briefing (reg_changes), Impact Analysis (reg_diff+reg_graph), Completeness Audit (reg_coverage+reg_inventory).
Acceptance Criteria: Three skills live on the platform; each produces correct, cited output on test prompts

Title: Agent citation & accuracy evaluation
Description: Run the 20-question eval across ≥8 regulators: every claim cited (regulator+reference+date+URL), superseded docs flagged with successor, out-of-corpus questions declined.
Acceptance Criteria: Eval sheet completed with pass/fail per question; failures fed back into prompt/tool fixes

Title: Daily delta poller & weekly deep run
Description: Single scheduler entrypoint: fleet delta ingest (giants depth-sliced), pending-edge resolution, integrity reconcile, projection resync, one-line delta summary; weekly --deep raises caps.
Acceptance Criteria: One cron line each for daily/weekly; exit code signals invariant violations; every run visible in UI

Title: Backup & restore
Description: Nightly consistent SQLite snapshot + hardlink-incremental corpus backup with 7-day retention; restore verified.
Acceptance Criteria: Backup runs while server/crawls active; restore drill opens snapshot with full document count; retention enforced portably

Title: UX polish round
Description: Excerpt/description line + source links + Added date in corpus; PDF filename titles (incl. backfill); add-doc discoverability in top bar; rich-render defaults.
Acceptance Criteria: No raw URLs as titles; every row shows an honest excerpt where text exists; date column always populated

Title: Successor knowledge base
Description: Author the handover KB: start-here mental model, architecture/flows/schema, UI+tools reference, testing/ops runbook, known issues + war stories + roadmap.
Acceptance Criteria: A new engineer/AI agent can operate and extend the system from the KB alone

Title: BA: final UAT & product-owner acceptance
Description: End-to-end acceptance against the epic-level outcomes; PO sign-off for go-live.
Acceptance Criteria: Acceptance record signed; open items dispositioned to backlog

Title: PM: go/no-go readiness review & handover
Description: Deployment readiness review, handover of runbooks/KB, closure report.
Acceptance Criteria: Readiness review held; handover acknowledged

Title: Federal Register full text via govinfo.gov bulk data
Description: Replace abstract/stub fallback with sanctioned full text from GPO govinfo bulk repository (separate host built for programmatic bulk use).
Acceptance Criteria: Full text for new FR docs; existing stubs self-heal to full text as revisions; no ToS risk

Title: Simple-mode overview landing page
Description: First-time-user landing: one plain-English headline, ≤4 tiles, one regulator×(web/PDF/today delta/health-dot) table; ops detail moves behind drill-ins; analyst vs operator modes.
Acceptance Criteria: New user answers 'what do we have / what changed today / is it healthy' in <10s without training

Title: Playwright fetch path for JS-heavy sites
Description: Browser-rendered fetching for regulators whose listings require JavaScript (MAS, some NYDFS).
Acceptance Criteria: fetch:playwright configs ingest content where plain HTTP yields none

Title: PostgreSQL migration
Description: Flip db.type to Postgres using the shipped DDL; enable pg_trgm for title-similarity reference resolution.
Acceptance Criteria: All tests green on Postgres; no write-lock contention during concurrent crawl+agent load

Title: Expected inventories for EBA / FCA / APRA
Description: Extend completeness proofs beyond OSFI using each regulator's official register/index.
Acceptance Criteria: Per-series present/missing for 3 more regulators; gaps drive targeted gap-fills

Title: Weekly digest webhook
Description: Teams/email digest generated from the changes feed (per-desk filters).
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduled digest delivered with citations; opt-in filters per audience

Title: AMF Québec access via official whitelisting
Description: Engage AMF for institutional IP/UA whitelisting (site bot-blocks all automation); fallback: licensed feed.
Acceptance Criteria: AMF collecting via sanctioned access; zero evasion techniques used

Title: Production hardening
Description: Pre-exposure hardening: replace default admin credentials, TLS/reverse proxy, restricted bind, secrets management, key rotation SOP.
Acceptance Criteria: Security checklist passed before any non-localhost exposure

Title: OCR for scanned policy PDFs
Description: Tesseract path for image-only PDFs (currently 6 docs, 97% extract fine without).
Acceptance Criteria: ocr:true docs gain searchable text; volume-triggered (revisit if scanned share grows)

Title: LLM enrichment integration
Description: Wire the owner's LLM gateway into the enrichment slot: real summaries (summary.md), taxonomy topic tags, doc-type reclassification, date/deadline extraction; golden-set eval gates.
Acceptance Criteria: Summaries replace excerpts; doc_type distribution reflects reality (not 90% announcement); deadline feed populated; eval ≥90% tagging accuracy
